name: ohos-native-bindings-demos
description: ArkTS UI host app for the ohos-native-bindings Rust examples

scripts.build:test: arkdown build --project . --target hap --mode debug --module entry --build-target-name ohosTest --checker oxc
scripts.onDeviceTest: arkdown --mode module -p module=entry -p product=default -p ohos-test-coverage=false onDeviceTest
scripts.run: npm run sync:rust && npm run build:hap && npm run install:hap && npm run start
